biggest_catch: The $1,000 tier requires $20,000 in new money within 30 days and maintaining a $20,000 daily balance for 60 more days. Business accounts only; the offer ends October 14, 2026; account must stay open 90 days.
catches: Click Apply Online or Open at a Branch from the official offer page so the promotion code is claimed at account opening.

$400 tier: open a new Huntington Unlimited Business Checking, Unlimited Plus Business Checking, Business Analyzed, Non Profit Analyzed, or Non Profit Interest Checking account by October 14, 2026; make total new-money deposits of $5,000 or more within 60 days of account opening; maintain open account status for 90 days.

$1,000 tier: open a new Huntington Unlimited Plus Business Checking account by October 14, 2026; make total new-money deposits of $20,000 or more within 30 days of account opening, then maintain a daily balance of $20,000 or more for 60 days after meeting the initial deposit requirement; maintain open account status for 90 days.
New money = money not currently on deposit in any Huntington account (except maturing business CDs); transfers from another Huntington deposit account do not count.
Available only to applicants residing in AL, AR, CO, FL, GA, IL, IN, KY, LA, MI, MN, MS, MO, NC, OH, OK, PA, SC, TN, TX, WV, or WI.
Account must maintain an open status for at least 90 days before it is eligible for the bonus payment; all new accounts subject to approval; account conversions not eligible.

steps: Click Apply Online or Open at a Branch on the official Huntington business offer page so the promotion code is claimed at account opening.
Open the new business checking account by October 14, 2026 (Unlimited Plus for the $1,000 tier; any of the five listed accounts for the $400 tier).

Make the required new-money deposits ($5,000 in 60 days for $400; $20,000 in 30 days for $1,000) and maintain the required balance ($20,000 daily for 60 days after the deposit requirement for the $1,000 tier).
Keep the account open for at least 90 days to be eligible for the bonus payment.
